say:3:1423428002:1.text: Ravion sent us. We're here to help!
say:3:1423428002:1.source_cn: 其实是沙利叶请我们来帮你的啦！

say:4:1423428003:1.text: Great. In that case, I'll gladly take the help...
say:4:1423428003:1.source_cn: 那么时间紧急，我也不客气了……

say:5:1423428004:1.text: We're short on everything—people, supplies, even basic things like wood and stone...
say:5:1423428004:1.source_cn: 现在我这里人手和材料都不足，连最基本的木料和石材都缺……

say:6:1423428005:1.text: Could you help gather some <style="highlight">wood</style> and <style="highlight">stone</style>?
say:6:1423428005:1.source_cn: 可以请你们去帮我找些<style=highlight>...

say:7:1423428006:1.text: You'll probably find wood around the commoners' district. For stone, check near the lift, where the dwarves used to work!
say:7:1423428006:1.source_cn: 木料平民区就有，石材可能得到矮人们工作过的升降机附近找找了！
